title: One-Bit Dither — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: The idea grows from density
scenes.purpose: Grow an ordered-dither density pattern into a readable light-bulb shape on a dark one-bit field.
visuals: Dark ink field on fixed 320x180 grid
Radial dithered glow expanding from the bulb centre
Solid bulb glass and dark base bands resolve
AN IDEA bitmap title on solid ink backing

beats.development: Solid ink field; first sparse threshold dots appear at the bulb centre.
Title AN IDEA appears with its backing; density threshold rises so the glow spreads and the bulb shape locks to solid paper with dark base bands.

scenes.title: Threshold boundary switches the system
scenes.purpose: Move a threshold boundary rightward so the second region switches from ink to paper and the network draws as it passes.
visuals: Connector line leaves the bulb toward the panel
Dithered transition band travels left to right
Nodes, halos and links appear as the boundary crosses them

beats.development: Connector extends to the panel edge; the boundary sweeps across, switching the region and revealing nodes and links of the connected system.
Caption block appears on solid paper backing as the sweep completes.

scenes.title: Hold on the system
scenes.purpose: Settled two-value frame for reading the full message.
visuals: Bulb on dark field linked to the network on the switched light panel

beats.development: Static hold; the pattern reads as idea + connected system.

findings: Two clear threshold actions (growth 0.1–1.05s, boundary sweep 1.0–1.9s) with no dead time; composition settled by 1.9s.
justifiedHolds: 1.9–3.0s reading hold for the four-word caption and the settled shape, as the style asks to hold where the pattern reads as a shape.

notes: Renderer: Canvas 2D one-bit buffer (8x8 Bayer threshold, 4x nearest-neighbour); motion owner: one paused GSAP timeline at window.__timelines.video, redrawn on every seek and hf-seek.
No reviewed preview recipes were listed; the catalogue characteristic action is demonstrated.
